Nora: Quick thread to lock webinar details: 'Practical Inference Choices: Benchmarks, Routing, and Runbooks' on Tue Sep 9 10:00 PT. Aim: drive Dedicated trials + Optimize signups. Need speakers, demo scope, reg form fields, rehearsal.

Ben: I can do product framing (7m) + one slide with before/after metrics.

Aisha: I'll run a short live demo (12m) showing batching + cache hit-rate impact on cost. Need staging pod + warm cache.

Cal: I'll try to recruit a customer for a 5m voice clip. Legal check in progress. Also request reg form field: 'Deployment interest' (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and hidden 'account_owner'. Route Dedicated -> AE queue.

Nora: Draft run-of-show:
10:00-10:04 Intro + goals (Nora)
10:04-10:11 Product framing (Ben)
10:11-10:23 Demo (Aisha)
10:23-10:28 Customer snippet (Cal)
10:28-10:40 Q&A (panel)
10:40-10:45 Close + CTA (Nora)

Aisha: Rehearsal: tech check 30m prior, full dress Sep 8 09:00 PT. I'll post a short infra checklist in #eng-runtime.

Ben: Ill own the slide deck + TL;DR slide. Need screenshots of live metrics two days prior.

Nora: Marketing timeline: 14d announce blog + email, 7d paid/social, 2d reminder. Need headshots + 1-liner bios by next Wed. I'll build the reg page with UTM capture.

Cal: Action items recap: Ben = deck; Aisha = reserve pod + checklist; Cal = customer sign-off; Nora = landing + emails + rehearsal invites.

CalendarBot: Event and rehearsal invites created: Webinar Sep 9 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT, Dress Sep 8 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT.
